thank_you.body: For making the journey to Earlsdon, and for giving your evening to Shakespeare in Love. We hope you'll come back.

venue.body: The Criterion has staged over 450 productions since 1955, in a building that is over 140 years old — an 1884 Methodist chapel that became a theatre in 1960. It is run entirely by its members: no paid employees, on stage or off.
venue.footline: Registered charity 1161430 • A volunteer-run theatre in Earlsdon, Coventry
venue.headline: The Criterion

volunteer.body: Actors, makers, technicians, front-of-house, bar and box office — every part of the Criterion is volunteer-run, and new members are always welcome. No experience needed to get involved on stage, backstage, or around the building.

_phase_plan: Playlists follow docs/design/foyer-purpose-for-directors.md (11 Oct 2026 rework). PRESHOW: arrive and know what tonight is - tonight's cards as anchors; a tease of the making; a little Elizabethan context; the bar and interval pre-order; what's on next. INTERVAL: much less, much larger - what is served and when to be back. POSTSHOW: something to say - the making revealed, the history as conversation starters, the theatre's longer memory, the bar stays open, come back, take part.
